findings.title: No CONTRIBUTING guide for external contributors
findings.detail: 100 contributors but no CONTRIBUTING.md — add setup + PR conventions.

findings.title: Almost no docstrings/JSDoc (0% of 476 functions)
findings.detail: Document public functions at minimum — the exported API surface.

findings.title: Bus factor is 1
findings.detail: One person accounts for 50%+ of all contributions. Key-person risk: document decisions, add CODEOWNERS, recruit co-maintainers.

findings.title: 1 circular module dependency detected
findings.detail:
• src/validator → src/middleware → src/adapter → src/client → src/jsx → src/helper → src/utils → src → src/router → src/validator
Cycles make modules untestable in isolation — break them by extracting a shared lower-level module.

plan.title: Rotate the exposed private key immediately
plan.detail: Generate a new key pair, update every consumer, and purge the old key from git history with git filter-repo. Consider it compromised from the moment it was pushed.

plan.title: Move hardcoded credentials out of source
plan.detail: Replace with environment variables, then rotate each value — it is already in history.

plan.title: Refactor the highest-complexity functions
plan.detail: Start with the top 5 offenders: extract helpers, replace branch chains with early returns and lookup tables. Target cx ≤ 10 per function.

plan.title: Sanitize dangerouslySetInnerHTML input
plan.detail: Render text instead where possible; otherwise sanitize with DOMPurify before injecting.

plan.title: Flatten deeply nested code
plan.detail: Introduce guard clauses/early returns and invert conditions — nesting beyond 4 levels hides logic bugs.

plan.title: Flesh out the README
plan.detail: Add installation, usage with examples, and a short FAQ/troubleshooting section.

plan.title: Split god files into focused modules
plan.detail: Group by responsibility (parsing, IO, orchestration) and extract classes/modules; keep files under ~300 lines.

plan.title: Extract shared helpers from duplicated blocks
plan.detail: The flagged clones drift apart silently — consolidate each group into one function.

plan.title: Reduce key-person risk
plan.detail: Document architecture decisions (ADRs), add CODEOWNERS, and onboard at least one co-maintainer.

plan.title: Break circular module dependencies
plan.detail: 1 cycle(s) detected in the module graph — extract shared lower-level modules until dependencies form a DAG.

plan.title: Add a CONTRIBUTING guide
plan.detail: Document local setup, conventions, and the PR process.

plan.title: Adopt a docstring/JSDoc convention
plan.detail: Document all exported functions first; enforce with eslint-plugin-jsdoc / ruff pydocstyle.
